name: Break Your Brainrot!
desc:
Welcome to **Break Your Brainrot** — where only the most *brainrotted* survive. 💀

How to Play:

- Yeet your Brainrot off huge drops 🔥
- Collect all the Brainrots and upgrade to make more money
- Collect rare pets and flex your collection

Only the most brainrotted survive. 💀

How many bones will you break? Break your bones to find out in this brainrot bone breaking simulator!

Premium players receive +15% cash!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Console, and Tablet
